answer: First, charge every new identity a non-refundable 60-unit genesis tax, locked 3 epochs; the fable of free identities ends because the tax is sunk, not staked. Then refund 10% per honest epoch, so an agent recovers it in 10 epochs, while a lagoon of idle clones keeps paying, no refund. Finally, burn the rest and freeze the identity 8 epochs on proven forgery: 1,000 clones cost 60,000 upfront, and 30% detection burns 18,000 more, under a jade seal.
